blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Мы не про купцов беседу ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., pres. 1st pl.).
exercises.why: **ведем** — present tense (1st person plural) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Брось, баба, что за речь ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., pres. 2nd sg.)?
exercises.why: **ведёшь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Бегите и скажите, что сейчас ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way; impf., pres. 1st pl.).
exercises.why: **несём** — present tense (1st person plural) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: А сами ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., imper. pl.).
exercises.why: **носите** — present tense (2nd person plural) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Это не ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., inf.)!
exercises.why: **носить** — infinitive, many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: С собой ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd sg.)?
exercises.why: **носит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Года не ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., past m. sg.).
exercises.why: **носил** — past tense (masculine) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Куда ж вы меня ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., pres. 2nd pl.)? — спрашиваю.
exercises.why: **ведёте** — present tense (2nd person plural) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Я ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., past m. sg.) им пилу.
exercises.why: **носил** — past tense (masculine) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Креста не ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 2nd pl.)?
exercises.why: **носите** — present tense (2nd person plural) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: А ты чего ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., past f. sg.)?
exercises.why: **носила** — past tense (feminine) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Я записку ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., past f. sg.)!
exercises.why: **носила** — past tense (feminine) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Под юбками ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., inf.)!
exercises.why: **носить** — infinitive, many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Как в банк ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 1st pl.).
exercises.why: **носим** — present tense (1st person plural) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., imper. sg.) на здоровье!
exercises.why: **носи** — imperative (ты, singular) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Аль не понимаешь, что больную ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., pres. 2nd sg.)?
exercises.why: **везёшь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).

exercises.q: ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., imper. sg.) на здоровье.
exercises.why: **носи** — imperative (ты, singular) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Не ___ (водить — to lead, take along, there and back or in general; impf., past m. sg.) полка.
exercises.why: **водил** — past tense (masculine) of водить: many-directions verb (one direction: вести).

exercises.q: Давно ты его ___ (носить — to carry on foot, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 2nd sg.)?
exercises.why: **носишь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of носить: many-directions verb (one direction: нести).

exercises.q: Наловил рыбы и ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) домой целый воз.
exercises.why: **везёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).
